mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, here is today's balanced dish: skies are clear near Badger Prairie County Park under a full moon. There is an ISS pass tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

The city has announced that a portion of Hwy M near the new Aldi site will be closed for road work from October 5 to October 7. Additionally, the Planning Department is warning residents of a scam involving fake emails that impersonate city officials to solicit payments.

We have a busy couple of days ahead. The Dane County Farmer's Market is today, along with live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking forward, Yoga at Insight Wellness is September 28, followed by various trivia nights starting September 29.
Regarding local safety, on September 5, officers investigated reports of vehicles with cheese slices on their windshields, which was linked to a social media prank trend.
Today is a great day to visit Culver's for their Flavor of the Day, OREO REESE'S Cheesecake. They are currently open and will be serving up scoops until 10:30 PM tonight.
